(2) The scene shifts to include a man in a black polo shirt standing next to the woman in a room with a grand piano. They both clap their hands together in a prayer-like gesture, laughing and looking at each other. Variety-show style text overlays and graphic symbols (warning signs) appear on screen. (3) The man prepares to sing while the woman sits at the piano, her back to the camera. The camera cuts between the man's concentrated facial expression and the woman's hands moving over the ivory keys. Sheet music is visible on the piano's stand. (4) The woman is back in a standing position, clapping enthusiastically and cheering. Animated confetti and colorful name tags appear on the screen to introduce a new person. (5) A third person, a man with long gray hair in a ponytail and a black turtleneck, is shown in profile and then facing the camera. He sings with intense facial expressions and wide mouth movements. The woman is partially visible in the background, accompanying him on the piano.
